name: 46032 · Carmel, IN
findings: ZIP 46032 (Carmel) has 381 nonprofit organizations. 168 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 152 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46032 (Carmel) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46032 (Carmel) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).
